tooltip.emergence.block: Structural material. Joins every part it touches into one rigid body; touching a world block anchors it.
tooltip.emergence.shaft: Round rod. Rotates freely only where it passes through bearings on one axis line.
tooltip.emergence.bearing: Lets a shaft passing through it rotate. Friction from load and bearing type.
tooltip.emergence.gear: Meshes with another gear of the same tooth module whose rim it touches.
tooltip.emergence.crank: Mount on a shaft; hold right-click to turn it (sneak: reverse, sprint: harder).
tooltip.emergence.magnet: Uniformly magnetised block; red cap = north face (magnetisation along placement axis).
tooltip.emergence.coil: Enamelled copper winding. Single-cell coils bring their leads out sideways (lead axis); longer coils at their end layers.
tooltip.emergence.wire: Bare conductor: contacts any conductor it touches.
tooltip.emergence.insulated_wire: Insulated conductor: connects only to wires and component leads.
tooltip.emergence.resistor: Leads at both axial ends. Burns out if overheated.
tooltip.emergence.diode: Silicon PN junction. Anode on the negative-axis lead, cathode (band) on the positive.
tooltip.emergence.brush: Sliding contact: conducts to a rotating conductor in front of its face.
tooltip.emergence.multimeter: Right-click a part: temperature, voltage, current, power, speed.
tooltip.emergence.place_hint: Fills the block in front of the clicked face (scale model, 1 block = 6.25 cm). Click a shaft's side to mount on it; sneak to place along your view. Tweezers in off-hand: miniature mode.
message.emergence.does_not_fit: That part does not fit inside one block space here.
tooltip.emergence.electrolyte: A glass jar of solution. Conductors dipped into it become electrodes: cells, corrosion, plating and electrolysis follow from electrochemistry.
tooltip.emergence.precision_tweezers: Hold in the off-hand to place parts as true-scale miniatures (16 cells per block) instead of one part per block.
message.emergence.scale_mismatch: Block-scale and miniature parts cannot share a block.
tooltip.emergence.pipe: Tube along its axis. Joins fluid parts at its ends (and sideways as a tee); an open end vents to the air. A shaft may run through it.
tooltip.emergence.tank: Hollow vessel of fluid; connects to fluid parts on every face. Heat its wall and the pressure rises.
tooltip.emergence.valve: Right-click to open or shut. Placed shut.
tooltip.emergence.rotor: Blade row mounted on a shaft in a pipe: driven, it pumps (fan, propeller, pump); in a flow, it is driven (turbine, windmill). Pitch sets which way.
tooltip.emergence.data_logger: Use on a part to log it at 1 kHz; its screen shows the trace while held. Use in the air: next channel; sneak: time base. /emergence log export saves CSV.
tooltip.emergence.source: A sealed source (school quantities): it decays with its half-life and its gamma rays travel in straight lines, thinned by distance (1/r²) and by what they pass through.
tooltip.emergence.gm_tube: Anode on its + lead, cathode on its − lead. Feed ~500 V through a megohm resistor: each ionising hit gives a pulse to count.
tooltip.emergence.potentiometer: A shaft passes through it like a bearing and turns a wiper along a resistive track: an angle sensor or a knob. Track ends on the lead-axis sides, wiper below; 300° between its end stops.
tooltip.emergence.opamp: Operational amplifier: + input on its back face, output on its front, supplies on its sides, − input below. Gain 10⁵, 3 MHz, output near the rails.
tooltip.emergence.photodiode: Silicon junction: light on its face drives current out of the anode (−) lead. Large ones are solar cells.
tooltip.emergence.chip: One pin pair of a 74HC-class chip: lay segments of the same chip in a row along their axis.
tooltip.emergence.brake: Friction pad: its face presses on whatever turns in front of it (torque μ·F·r). Use it to apply or release.
tooltip.emergence.cylinder: Bore with a piston. Point its rod (+axis) face at a crank throw on a shaft, a block or more away: the gas pushes the crank (engine) or the crank pumps the gas (compressor). Head and sides take pipes.
tooltip.emergence.eccentric: Mount on a shaft. Connecting rods of cylinders pointing at the shaft ride on its pin; where each cylinder sits around the shaft sets its timing.
tooltip.emergence.transistor: Emitter/source on the −axis face, collector/drain on the +axis face, base/gate on the sides. Bipolar (Ebers–Moll) or MOSFET physics.
tooltip.emergence.led: Anode on the −axis lead, cathode on +axis. Light from recombining electrons: the colour sets the forward voltage.
tooltip.emergence.logic: CMOS logic (74HC class). Input A / D on the −axis face, output on +axis, GND and V_DD on the −/+ lead-axis sides, input B / clock on the remaining −side, Q̄ on its +side.
